reduced-grey-1.0.0.name: Reduced Grey Atmosphere
limitations: No convection, clouds, or atmospheric dynamics
Greenhouse optical depth is a single lumped parameter

qhf-viability-1.0.0.name: QHF Organism Viability Model
limitations: Gaussian tolerance curves, not empirically fitted
pH and salinity are assumed priors, not derived
Missing data silently ignored (should be explicit)

confidence_categories.observed: Directly measured by instrument (e.g., transit radius)
confidence_categories.inferred: Derived from observations with model assumptions (e.g., mass from RV)
confidence_categories.estimated: Computed from other parameters using a model (e.g., luminosity from T_eff and R)
confidence_categories.assumed: Set to a default or illustrative value without specific evidence (e.g., albedo = 0.30)
confidence_categories.illustrative: Chosen for educational purposes, not based on a specific planet (e.g., custom atmosphere)
confidence_categories.unknown: Cannot be determined from available data
